reply_text:
Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, addressed to you.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. The channel shows the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while the kiosks were down. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when Mateo logged that the guard had checked in trailer 8836. Both lanes were working by 11:07 AM.
